listing.aiSummary: Adjusts AI fleet compositions and officer assignments to increase combat difficulty.

description:
Better Variants aims to make combat more challenging by adjusting the composition of AI fleets. Features include:

New and reworked ship variants in AI fleets
Smarter assignments of officers to ships and officer skills
Autofit (ie random ship variants) being disabled for most vanilla factions and fleets
Special, randomly occurring, themed fleets with unique compositions
A bar mission for fighting themed fleets
Settings which can be changed via Luna Lib or file (VariantsLib/data/variants_lib/variants_lib_settings.json and BetterVariants/data/bettervariants/better_variants_settings.json)
descriptionHtml:
Better Variants aims to make combat more challenging by adjusting the composition of AI fleets. Features include:

  • New and reworked ship variants in AI fleets
  • Smarter assignments of officers to ships and officer skills
  • Autofit (ie random ship variants) being disabled for most vanilla factions and fleets
  • Special, randomly occurring, themed fleets with unique compositions
  • A bar mission for fighting themed fleets
  • Settings which can be changed via Luna Lib or file (VariantsLib/data/variants_lib/variants_lib_settings.json and BetterVariants/data/bettervariants/better_variants_settings.json)
aiDescription: Reworks ship variants in AI fleets and disables autofit for vanilla factions. Introduces special themed fleets with unique compositions and a bar mission to fight them. Includes settings configurable via Luna Lib or JSON files.

changelog.1.5.0:
Updated to 0.98
 Adjusted some fleets, variants, and officer assignment logic
 Requires VariantsLib 0.5.5 or higher to run
changelog.1.4.3:
Added Luna Lib as an optional dependency for LunaSettings. If Luna Lib is not enabled, the values in BetterVariants/data/bettervariants/better_variants_settings.json are used
 VariantsLib has also gotten Luna Lib as an optional dependency. If Luna Lib is not enabled, values in VariantsLib/data/variants_lib/variants_lib_settings.json are used
 Added the "Harder Remnants" setting, which disables autofit for remnants, gives their officers more relevant skills, and gives them randomly occurring themed fleets
 VariantsLib has also gotten a new setting called "Universal No Autofit", which disables autofit for the fleets of all factions
 Fixed bugs related to variants not being deep copied before assignment
 Requires VariantsLib 0.5.3 or greater to run
changelog.1.4.2: Fixed some hulls in Persean and Luddic Church fleets and markets not showing up as much as they should
